description: Query the Meta Insights edge with validated native field names, breakdowns, action breakdowns, attribution windows, filters, sort, summary, and pagination. This complements meta_get_insights when Meta adds fields before the curated metric catalog is updated.

actionAttributionWindows.description: Meta attribution windows used to attribute action metrics.

actionBreakdowns.description: Meta action-level breakdowns, subject to Insights compatibility rules.

after.description: Opaque cursor for the next page returned by Meta.

breakdowns.description: Native reporting breakdowns. Check compatibility before combining them.

datePreset.description: Named reporting period. Use the custom date range when you need exact start and end dates.

fields.description: Native Meta Insights API fields; calculated aliases are not accepted here

filtering.description: Native provider filter expressions; credentials and account overrides are not allowed.

includeSummary.description: Request the provider's available summary or total-count metadata.

level.description: Entity or aggregation level for the requested report.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

objectId.description: Ad account (act_...), campaign, ad set, or ad ID whose /insights edge should be queried

timeIncrement.description: Provider time-bucket size or supported aggregate value.

timeRange.description: Explicit provider reporting period with since and until dates.

name: meta_get_insights_raw

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: meta get insights raw
